As a first-time sole trader with simple income, the **Self Assessment Simple** package at £119 per tax year would likely be the most suitable option for you. This package is designed for straightforward tax situations, making it a good fit for someone just starting out.

If you have any specific questions about what’s included in the package or need help with the registration process, feel free to ask! You can also find more details about the Self Assessment packages [here](https://www.taxsimba.

As a landlord needing Making Tax Digital (MTD), the lowest suitable plan is **Simbian Comply**, which costs **£29.99 per month** (VAT included). This plan includes the necessary digital bookkeeping and preparation for your MTD obligations.

You can sign up for Self Assessment or Making Tax Digital (MTD) packages on the TaxSimba website. Here are the links for each:

- For Self Assessment packages, visit: [Self Assessment Packages](https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/self-assessment)
- For MTD packages, check out: [Making Tax Digital Packages](https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/making-tax-digital)

If you have any specific questions about the packages or need help deciding which one is right for you, feel free to ask!
